description: This file contains functions for managing firmware operations such as fetching firmware status, uploading firmware files, activating firmware, and initiating firmware upgrades, with environment-specific mock behaviors.

methods.name: getFirmwareStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current firmware status, returning mock data in development environment or data from API in production.

methods.name: uploadFirmware
methods.description: Uploads a firmware file to the server, with mock behavior in development environment.

methods.name: activateFirmware
methods.description: Activates a specific firmware bank, with mock behavior in development environment.

methods.name: upgradeFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a firmware upgrade process with specified firmware file and auto-activation option.
